summary: Highline evacuation of elderly residents across the flood-stage river in Salina after the town was cut off; a 10-person Alpine team hiked in via high wooded ridges and ferried residents across in a litter on a single-track highline
notes: Named evacuees: 76-year-old Douglas Burger and his wife; "several" elderly residents plus pets (three dogs and a canary) evacuated — victims recorded as the two named evacuees. Alpine deployed to the Boulder County airport Incident Command Post under a CSRB mutual-aid request.
